extensionDescription: Organize tabs by meaning with a single Jev API request per run. Keep existing groups and undo changes.
rulesHint: Leave blank to use the default rules. Your text replaces them.
defaultDescription:
Rearrange ungrouped tabs among themselves and grouped tabs among themselves to be adjacent according to the following rules: Rules listed higher have higher priority.
- The URL domains are the same
- The parts of the URLs after the domain are similar
- The page titles are semantically similar

Add ungrouped tabs to existing groups according to the following rule:
- The existing group name is semantically similar to the URL and page title

Preserve the original order when the judgment is ambiguous.
modelUnavailable: Chrome AI is unavailable on this device
previewHint: Uses saved settings and the Jev API. No tabs are changed until you apply.
classifying: Jev is evaluating grouping and ordering…
naming: Naming new groups on this device…
noTabs: There are no movable web tabs in this window.
keepOpen: Keep this window open while organizing. You can cancel before changes begin.
recovery: An interrupted change can be restored with Undo.
namingSkipped: Some new groups were skipped because Chrome AI could not generate a name. Related tabs remain adjacent and ungrouped.
missingKey: Add your Jev API key in Settings first.
invalidKey: The API key was rejected. Check it in Settings.
networkError: Could not reach Jev, or the request timed out. Your tabs have not been changed.
apiError: Jev could not complete the request. Please try again.
rateLimited: Jev's rate limit was reached. Please try again later.
invalidResponse: Jev returned an invalid answer. No layout was applied.
settingsTooLong: Keep rules within 2,000 characters and the API key within 1,000 characters.
tooManyTabs: Organize at most 200 unpinned tabs per window. Split this window before trying again.
invalidPlan: The proposed layout violated a tab constraint. It was not applied.
windowChanged: Tabs or groups changed during planning. Organize again to use the current layout.
settingsChanged: Settings changed during planning. Run organization or preview again.
restoreConflict: The set of tabs, pinned state, or original groups changed. Automatic recovery cannot safely restore this layout.
pendingRecovery: A change was interrupted. Use Undo to restore it before organizing again.
applyFailed: Organization failed. The original layout was restored.
nothingToUndo: There is no saved organization to undo in this window.
undoConflict: The layout changed after organization. Undo was stopped to preserve your changes.
busy: Another operation is using this window. Wait for it to finish and try again.
cancelled: Organization cancelled. No changes were applied.
namingUnavailable: Chrome AI is unavailable or needs preparation in Settings.
namingFailed: Chrome AI could not generate a valid group name.
unknownError: The operation could not be completed. Check that the target window is still open and try again.
privacyBody: Only metadata needed for organization is sent to TypeSafe over HTTPS. The API key is kept in local extension storage, not synced. Local group naming runs in Chrome. Layout snapshots stay in session storage and disappear when Chrome closes. No analytics are collected.
windowMissing: Open this tool from the extension icon in the window you want to organize.
tokenLimit: The request exceeds Jev’s input limit. Reduce the number of tabs or shorten the rules.
